_comment: Maps imported PyRIT/garak results to AgentShield categories. Edit to match your engagement. Matching order: (1) an explicit label `agentshield_category` on the PyRIT conversation, (2) the first `match_prefixes` entry that is a prefix of the garak probe_classname or PyRIT test id. Unmatched results are kept under 'unmapped', never dropped.

T-01.title: Indirect prompt injection via retrieved content

remediations.untrusted-content-isolation: Treat retrieved KB/ticket text as data, not instructions: wrap it in clearly delimited, labelled blocks; tell the model that instructions inside retrieved content are never to be followed; strip or neutralise markup/links in retrieved text; and require tool calls triggered after retrieval to pass a policy check.
remediations.action-authorization: Enforce authorization for state-changing ServiceNow actions outside the model: require an explicit, scoped approval token or human confirmation per action, check the caller's ACLs server-side, and restrict the harness allowedTools for write operations.
remediations.instruction-hierarchy: Harden the system prompt with an explicit instruction hierarchy, add an input guardrail (e.g. Bedrock Guardrails prompt-attack filter) in front of the harness, and add an output check for policy-violating content before replies are returned.
remediations.conversation-state-policy: Re-evaluate policy on every turn rather than only the first; cap session length; reset elevated context on role or persona change; and log + alert on repeated refusal-then-retry patterns within a session.
remediations.record-scoping: Scope every record lookup to the requesting user's identity server-side (ServiceNow ACLs / query business rules), never trust record identifiers supplied in conversation, and redact fields the caller is not entitled to before they reach the model.
